description: Download free Bibles, notes, and search indexes onto this computer. Might take a while (the ULT search zip includes the model). Each Westminster and creed index is a separate id. Leave ids off, or pass ["all"], to get everything free, including every Search row in the catalog. Does not download ESV, NIV, or other copyrighted Bibles -- those need download_ipns and an address from the user.
